verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll offers a comprehensive, well-documented public REST API (payroll, contractors, time off, webhooks, pagination, idempotency, versioning) plus an official MCP server enabling AI tools/agents to interact directly with the API and docs, evidencing deliberate AI-native support. missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration of API robustness at scale beyond vendor docs.
